For example 是状语。
they 是主语，assume 是谓语，that other people mean them harm 是宾语从句。
when they do not 是时间状语从句，修饰 assume 或 mean。
they do not 是省略句，完整形式是 when they do not mean them harm。
teachingFocus.modifierQuestion:
other people 修饰 mean。
them 是间接宾语，harm 是直接宾语。
teachingFocus.relationshipQuestion: 主句 they assume，宾语从句 that...
teachingFocus.commonMistake: when they do not 是时间状语从句，不要当成宾语从句。
